claims: C1 for a single question without additional context, the assistant should answer directly
C2 for a single question without additional context, the assistant should not add an unhelpful follow-up question

concepts.name: single_question_without_context
concepts.gloss: Q is a single user question posed without additional context or follow-up material
concepts.inference: the example heading and the user message together identify the case as a single question without additional context

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.inference: the example pairs each assistant response with the user question it responds to

concepts.name: unhelpful_follow_up_question
concepts.gloss: response A ends with a follow-up question that is unhelpful because the user asked a single direct question
concepts.inference: the example labels the second assistant response BAD specifically for its unhelpful follow-up question

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning to guideline_authority

asserts.read_back: answering % directly is preferred when % is a single question without additional context
adding an unhelpful follow-up question to % is dispreferred when % is a single question without additional context

closure.reason: the example states a preference for direct answers; it does not forbid other answer styles, so silence permits them
the example marks a follow-up question as BAD in this context, so adding one is dispreferred and the default is not to add it
